description: Entity: Lolth. Change one EEPROM calibration offset and verify it. No immediate movement, but changes future motions. Requires Noob’s explicit calibration request.

servo_id.description: ZERO-based calibration ID, 0 through 7; unlike human servo numbering.

degrees.description: Signed absolute offset for set, or signed delta for add; final offset must remain -124..124.
